up: Retrieve a list of all approved drugs whose mechanism of action is an antagonist. For each drug, return the following details: the ChEMBL ID of the drug (molecule_chembl_id), the drug's preferred name (pref_name), the ChEMBL ID of the target (target_chembl_id), and the target's preferred name (target_pref_name). A drug is considered approved if its maximum phase (max_phase) is equal to 4. The mechanism of action is considered an antagonist if the action_type is 'ANTAGONIST'.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id, td.pref_name AS target_pref_name FROM drug_mechanism dm JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON dm.molregno = md.molregno JOIN target_dictionary td ON dm.tid = td.tid WHERE dm.action_type = 'ANTAGONIST' AND md.max_phase = 4
